ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-gray) occupying approximately 75% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels concentrated at the distal tips and along the irregular trailing edge boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-gray central mass; high-contrast white mottling at the extreme left and right distal margins; numerous discrete, small-scale high-intensity circular pixel clusters (barnacles) distributed across the dark regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees and a significant depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; distal tips exhibit extreme jaggedness with peak-to-valley pixel displacements exceeding 20 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral symmetrical sweep with a primary concave curvature originating from the median notch transitioning into a convex outer margin towards the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial clusters of circular, high-contrast white/beige pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated on the extreme distal tips and along the upper trailing edge peaks.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct unaligned linear pixel disruptions: one horizontal white rake mark on the lower-left lobe and one diagonal white scratch on the lower-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization causing physical surface texture variation at distal tips; visible linear scarring/rake marks on the ventral lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized yellow-brown high-intensity staining (potential diatom accumulation) on the upper-right lobe near the trailing edge margin.
